Select IC50 measurements for compounds tested against human Tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 1. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Use the provenance-rich join path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Filter by target name 'Tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 1' and target organism 'Homo sapiens'. Filter activities for standard_type 'IC50'. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
